inspiration.observed_pattern: A scalar CRC32 call computes the unsigned checksum of a text value.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored grouped artifact-checksum audit. CRC32 is applied to nullable payloads, MAX aggregates per-bundle checksums, and CASE labels bundles with no payload or a high unsigned checksum. The source scalar, schema, rows, aliases, and reporting purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Bundle 901 has two payloads and exposes the maximum checksum; bundle 902 mixes a NULL payload with one payload; bundle 903 contains only a NULL payload and exercises CRC32 NULL propagation through MAX and CASE.
determinism_notes: Bundle IDs, payload strings, and row IDs are fixed; grouped output is ordered by the unique bundle ID with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE artifact_parts (part_id INT PRIMARY KEY, bundle_id INT NOT NULL, payload VARCHAR(32) NULL)
INSERT INTO artifact_parts VALUES (1, 901, 'manifest-alpha-v1'), (2, 901, 'manifest-alpha-v2'), (3, 902, NULL), (4, 902, 'manifest-beta-v1'), (5, 903, NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT bundle_id, COUNT(*) AS part_count, MAX(CRC32(payload)) AS max_payload_checksum, CASE WHEN MAX(CRC32(payload)) IS NULL THEN 'empty' WHEN MAX(CRC32(payload)) >= 2147483648 THEN 'unsigned-high' ELSE 'standard' END AS checksum_class FROM artifact_parts GROUP BY bundle_id ORDER BY bundle_id
